description: Just a group of guys wanting to solve common farming issues
summary: We developed a decision-making tool for crop farmers. The app predicts the sowing period for a selection of crops using a harmonized regression model to allow for the development of crop-rotation strategies. This data-driven planning coordinates farming practices (summer/winter crops and fallow periods) to help build resilience to intensifying temperature and precipitation extremes.
details:
The app runs our Harmonic Regression Model processing land-surface temperature and precipitation data. An additional spread band covers the 30th and 70th percentiles including about the middle 40% of the respective data set. Moreover, the maxima and minima data points are indicated to highlight potential extreme.

We considered the crop lifecycle incl. temperature rainfall requirements to determine ideal conditions for crops and support optimal soil resilience. We categorised the crop lifecycle into four main stages: (1) sowing and establishment, (2) growth, (3) flowering, and (4) filling and hardening. We then looked into the temperature requirements for each stage of the lifecycle, such as the ideal temperature, as well as the upper and lower limits where frost and heat damage become a risk.
